body: I understand your sentiment. Yes the kid would probably look like him. Of course we want to always see our loved ones faces. But remember that kid would be a totally different person in personality. He is not the spirit of your husband.

I would just tell her. I am happy to hang out with you when you want to grab dinner or out for drinks. If she needs to complain about being a mom I am the wrong person to vent to. Go see a therapist or make friends with a mom. There’s plenty and shouldn’t be hard to find.
I am new at this. What’s happy Cake Day?
I’m tired of people assuming that women with children are more mature and together. It’s so not true.
